# Celestial Cartographers of the Soul
## Scripture
"But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession, that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light." - 1 Peter 2:9

## Reflection
As we gaze up at the night sky, we're reminded of the ancient cartographers who mapped the stars to navigate the vast expanse of the ocean. Similarly, as Christians, we're called to be celestial cartographers of the soul, mapping the depths of God's love and charting a course through the darkness. Just as the stars serve as beacons in the night, our lives can shine as lights, declaring the praises of God who has called us out of darkness into his wonderful light.

## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, help us to be celestial cartographers of the soul, navigating the depths of your love and charting a course through the darkness. May our lives shine as beacons, declaring your praises to a world in need. As we journey through the twists and turns of life, remind us that you are the North Star, guiding us towards your wonderful light. Empower us to be a royal priesthood, holy and special, that we may reflect your glory and love to all those around us.
